rationale: Stacks defines quasi-compactness by finite subcovers and defines a quasi-compact subset through its subspace topology; the second source records the widespread convention calling the cover condition compactness. The item combines those clauses, fixes finite-family and empty-space conventions, and adds library-specific cross-references, so it is a semantic compilation rather than an exact transcription. The URLs were retrieved through the model-side web route (HTTP 200). The item's false unrestricted ambient-invariance sentence is reported separately as a class-(a) defect.

The item expands the indexed version and the finite-choice bookkeeping, and its proof adapts the standard trace argument. Both URLs were retrieved through the model-side web route (HTTP 200). The overbroad ambient-invariance remark is reported separately.
